name: Ana
text: Status from my side, the QA workstream is mostly finished but the load tests are not.

name: Ana
text: Honest status is we expected the payment flow to be done and it is not done yet.

name: Marc
text: Status on the mobile workstream, the build is green and the store listing is finished.

name: Marc
text: What is not done that I expected is the push notification workstream, it slipped.

name: Vitaly
text: My status, the backend workstream is finished apart from the rate limiter.

name: Vitaly
text: What I expected to be done and is not done is the admin panel, honestly.

name: Ana
text: So the honest status overall is two workstreams late, payments and push notifications.

name: Marc
text: Agreed, that status is fair, mobile is the workstream closest to done.

name: Ana
text: For the date, I can defend October fourteenth if QA gets two more people.

name: Ana
text: Otherwise the date I can commit to out loud is the end of the month.

name: Vitaly
text: Honestly the pricing page needs a full redesign first, the tiers make no sense to customers.

name: Vitaly
text: The enterprise plan is way too cheap for what we give, and the free tier is too generous.

name: Vitaly
text: I looked at three competitors last week and they charge per seat with annual discounts.

name: Vitaly
text: We should also rename the plans, starter and growth sound generic, marketing agrees with me.

name: Vitaly
text: And the checkout page converts badly, the coupon field confuses people every single time.

name: Vitaly
text: If we fix pricing first the revenue projections change completely, so this matters now.

name: Vitaly
text: I can draft new tiers tonight and share a spreadsheet with seat prices and discounts.

name: Marc
text: On the date, I can commit to the fourteenth for mobile if the store review is quick.

name: Marc
text: So my date is the fourteenth, with the end of the month as the fallback date.

name: Ana
text: Then the date we commit to is the fourteenth, and we revisit it on Friday if QA is short.

name: Marc
text: Blockers, I will own the push notification blocker and the store review blocker.

name: Marc
text: Someone needs to own the rate limiter blocker, that one has no name against it.

name: Ana
text: I will take the load test blocker as owner and pair on the rate limiter blocker.

name: Ana
text: That leaves the admin panel blocker without an owner name.

name: Vitaly
text: I will own the rate limiter blocker and the admin panel blocker, put my name on both.

name: Marc
text: Good, so every blocker has an owner name against it now.

name: Ana
text: Yes, each blocker has a name, I will send the owner list after the call.
